Paracausal Attunement

You tap into the planetary consciousness network and wide-band sensory arrays:

  • Omniscience Cache: You learn three At-Will nanoprograms of your choice from any Operating System.
  • Dynamic Recalibration: When you finish a Short Rest, you can replace one prepared nanoprogram with another program from your OS.
  • Telepathic Hub: You establish a telepathic network with a number of willing creatures within 60 feet equal to your Wisdom modifier.
  • Relay Array: You can originate nanoprograms from the space of any of your active manifestations. Furthermore, Triangulated Targeting ensures your ranged attacks ignore half and three-quarters cover against targets within 10 feet of a node, and Noospheric Relay extends your Noetic Pulse command range to 120 feet.
